arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Fischl from Genshin Impact showing sweet affectionate longing. The supplied explicitly approved neutral is the sole image reference. Preserve its face, fair skin, blond twin tails and black ribbons, visible green right eye and normal pupil, black eyepatch covering the left eye, exact black-and-purple outfit, asymmetric sleeves and gloves, neck bow and gold ornaments, lace patterns, stockings and boots, and detailed anime illustration style. Keep the approved cute petite Medium Female proportions, compact torso and short natural limbs without elongating them.
Requested expression: noticeably blushing rosy cheeks and an unmistakably longing, wistful gaze toward the viewer. Keep her visible green eye open, with a softened gaze and gently raised inner brow. A small tender closed-mouth smile conveys a shy wish for affection. Let Fischl's theatrical confidence give way to sincere, bashful fondness. This is a gentle romantic emotion conveyed by face and eyes, with a modest natural standing pose. Her right hand rests lightly over her upper chest and her left gloved hand rests near her own waist, hands separated. A small head tilt and soft shoulder angle support the wistful expression; keep both feet grounded, slightly staggered and uncrossed. Maintain her established costume and a natural back posture.
Simple coherent hands near the torso and image plane, exactly two arms, two legs and two feet. Keep the eyepatch unchanged and the visible eye readable, with its ordinary pupil rather than a heart. Full silhouette including ribbons, twin tails, fingertips, costume tails and boots, with 2–4% top and bottom padding and roughly 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background. No scenery, floor, ground shadow, text, labels, UI, watermark, floating symbols, magic effects, weapons, raven, new props or other characters.
